resources.string: TodayRun follows your run from the first step to the last — distance, time, and pace, all captured for you.
Watch your path draw itself across the map in real time, and relive exactly where you ran afterwards.
Splits, weekly totals, and trends turn every run into progress you can actually see.
TodayRun draws your route from your precise location — approximate location can\'t follow a run. Allow precise location to start tracking your runs.
Precise location is turned off. Open Settings and allow precise location for TodayRun to track your runs.
